title: ATM Card
goalPhrases: how to get an atm card
summary: A bank-issued card for withdrawing cash and paying at shops. You typically need a PAN Card first.

authority.name: Your bank (branch or official banking channel)

requirements.label: PAN Card
requirements.detail: Needed as ID proof by the bank.

requirements.label: Active bank account
requirements.detail: A savings or current account with the bank issuing the card.

requirements.label: Registered mobile number
requirements.detail: Needed for OTP verification and alerts.

steps.title: Keep your PAN Card and account details ready.
Visit your bank branch or its official channel and request an ATM / debit card.
Verify your identity as asked (OTP or documents).
Collect the card and set your PIN as instructed by the bank.

obtain.where: Your bank branch, or the bank's official app, website, or customer care.
obtain.how: Cards are issued by banks, not by this guide. Ask your bank which channel it supports.

title: PAN Card
goalPhrases: how to get a pan card
summary: A 10-character tax identity number issued by the Income Tax Department. Commonly needed for banking and financial services.
uses: Open bank accounts and get an ATM card

conditions.text: You typically need to be an Indian citizen, resident, or an eligible applicant category — check the official instructions for your case.

requirements.label: Aadhaar
requirements.detail: Commonly used as proof of identity, address, and date of birth.

requirements.label: Recent photograph
requirements.detail: Passport-size, as per the official specifications.

requirements.label: Date of birth
requirements.detail: Must match your supporting documents.

requirements.label: Mobile number and email
requirements.detail: Needed for OTP verification and communication.

steps.title: Keep your Aadhaar, photograph, and personal details ready.
Open the official PAN application service (link below).
Fill the form exactly as per your documents.
Upload documents, verify with OTP, and pay the fee shown on the official site.
Save your acknowledgment number to check progress on the official site.

obtain.where: Through the official PAN service of the Income Tax Department.
obtain.how: Apply online on the official portal, or visit an authorized PAN service centre near you.

title: Aadhaar
summary: A 12-digit identity number issued by UIDAI after biometric enrolment. Widely used as ID and address proof.
uses: e-KYC for bank accounts, SIM cards, and PAN

conditions.text: Any resident of India can typically enrol — check the official enrolment rules for your situation.

requirements.label: Proof of identity and address
requirements.detail: Any one of these is typically accepted:

alternatives.label: Birth Certificate
alternatives.detail: For date-of-birth proof in some cases.

requirements.label: Biometric details
requirements.detail: Fingerprints, iris scan, and photograph are taken at the enrolment centre — no prior preparation needed.

requirements.label: Mobile number
requirements.detail: Needed for OTP verification during and after enrolment.

steps.title: Find your nearest Aadhaar enrolment centre on the official UIDAI site.
Carry an identity / address document with you.
Fill the enrolment form and give your biometric details at the centre.
Keep the enrolment slip safe to check status and download e-Aadhaar later.

obtain.how: Enrolment happens in person because biometrics are captured at the centre.

title: Passport
goalPhrases: how to apply for a passport
summary: Official travel document issued by the Ministry of External Affairs. Needed for international travel.
uses: Strong proof of identity, address, and citizenship

conditions.text: You must be an Indian citizen. Document lists differ slightly for minors, students, and government employees.

requirements.label: Aadhaar
requirements.detail: Commonly used for identity, address, and date-of-birth proof.

requirements.label: Address proof
requirements.detail: Any one of these is typically accepted:

alternatives.label: Recent utility bill or rent agreement
alternatives.detail: Electricity bill, water bill, or registered rent agreement.

requirements.label: Birth Certificate
requirements.detail: Typically needed as date-of-birth proof.

steps.title: Register on the official Passport Seva portal and fill the application.
Pay the fee shown on the portal and book an appointment.
Visit the Passport Seva Kendra with your original documents.
Complete police verification when scheduled, then track dispatch on the portal.

obtain.where: Passport Seva portal + Passport Seva Kendra appointment.
obtain.how: Apply online on the official portal first; the in-person visit follows your appointment.

title: Voter ID (EPIC)
summary: Photo identity card for registered voters, issued via the Election Commission of India. Needed to vote.

conditions.text: You must be 18 years or older on the qualifying date.
You must be ordinarily resident in the constituency where you register.

requirements.label: Age and address proof
requirements.detail: Aadhaar is commonly used; other proofs are listed on the official form.

requirements.label: Recent photograph
requirements.detail: Passport-size, as per the official specifications.

steps.title: Open the official voter registration service (link below).
Fill the new-registration form with your address and date of birth.
Upload age and address proof and submit.
Note your reference number and check the electoral roll after verification.

obtain.how: Register online on the official portal, or apply at your local electoral office / voter camp.

officialLinks.label: Election Commission of India — official site

title: Driving Licence
goalPhrases: how to get a driving licence
summary: Official permission to drive motor vehicles, issued by the State Transport Department after tests.
uses: Legally drive a car, bike, or other motor vehicle

conditions.text: You must be 18 or older for a permanent licence for most vehicle classes (16+ for gearless two-wheelers in some cases).
You typically need a learner's licence first and must pass the driving test.

requirements.label: Aadhaar
requirements.detail: Commonly used for identity, address, and age proof.

requirements.label: Learner's licence
requirements.detail: Issued before the permanent licence; usually requires holding it for a minimum period.

requirements.label: Medical certificate
requirements.detail: May be required if you are above 40 or applying for a transport-vehicle licence.
requirements.condition: You are above 40, or you are applying for a transport (commercial) vehicle licence.

steps.title: Apply for a learner's licence on the official Parivahan portal and pass the learner test.
Practise driving, then book your permanent-licence driving test slot.
Appear for the test with your documents and vehicle.
After passing, download your licence or receive it as instructed by your RTO.

obtain.where: State Transport Department / RTO via the Parivahan portal.
obtain.how: Apply online first, then visit the RTO for the driving test.

title: Birth Certificate
goalPhrases: how to get a birth certificate
summary: Official record of a birth, issued by the local Registrar of Births (municipal body). Needed as age proof for many services.
uses: Date-of-birth proof for school, passport, and Aadhaar

authority.name: Local municipal body / Registrar of Births and Deaths

conditions.text: Registration is simplest within 21 days of birth; rules differ for delayed registration — check with your local body.

requirements.label: Hospital discharge proof
requirements.detail: Discharge summary or birth report from the hospital.

requirements.label: Parents' identity details
requirements.detail: Names and ID details as asked on the registration form.

requirements.label: Affidavit for delayed registration
requirements.detail: May be required if registering long after the birth.
requirements.condition: You are registering well after the birth (for example, after 21 days — exact rules vary by state).

steps.title: Collect the hospital birth report and parents' ID details.
Apply at your municipal office or its official birth-registration portal.
Verify the details on the draft certificate carefully.
Collect the issued certificate and keep copies safe.

obtain.where: Your municipal corporation / nagar palika, or its official portal.
obtain.how: Registration rules vary by state, so confirm the local process before visiting.

title: Income Certificate
goalPhrases: how to get an income certificate
summary: It certifies a family's annual income. Commonly needed for scholarships, fee waivers, and welfare schemes.
uses: Apply for scholarships and fee waivers

conditions.text: You must be a resident of the state issuing the certificate — exact rules vary by state.

requirements.label: Aadhaar
requirements.detail: Commonly used for identity and address.

requirements.label: Residence proof
requirements.detail: Any one of these is typically accepted:

alternatives.label: Recent utility bill
alternatives.detail: Electricity or water bill in the applicant's or family member's name.

requirements.label: Income details
requirements.detail: Salary slips, employer letter, or self-declaration as asked by your state.

steps.title: Keep Aadhaar, residence proof, and income details ready.
Apply on your state's revenue / e-district portal or at the tehsil office.
Complete any local verification visit if asked.
Download or collect the certificate and check the validity period.

obtain.where: State Revenue Department — tehsil / taluka office or state e-district portal.
obtain.how: Process varies by state, so confirm the current form and fee on your state's official portal.

title: Caste Certificate
goalPhrases: how to get a caste certificate
summary: Certifies a person's caste / community. Needed for reservation benefits in education, jobs, and schemes.
uses: Claim reservation in admissions and government jobs

conditions.text: Issued only for castes / communities recognised in your state's official lists.

requirements.label: Aadhaar
requirements.detail: Commonly used for identity and address.

requirements.label: Domicile Certificate
requirements.detail: Often needed to show state residency.

requirements.label: Parent's caste certificate
requirements.detail: May be required depending on your state.
requirements.condition: Your state asks for proof of the family's recognised caste status.

steps.title: Keep Aadhaar, domicile proof, and family caste records ready.
Apply on your state's revenue / e-district portal or at the tehsil office.
Complete local verification if asked.
Collect the certificate and check the details carefully.

obtain.where: State Revenue Department — tehsil / taluka office or state e-district portal.
obtain.how: Process varies by state, so confirm the current form on your state's official portal.

title: Domicile Certificate
goalPhrases: how to get a domicile certificate
summary: Certifies that a person is a resident of a state. Often needed for admissions, jobs, and other certificates.
uses: Support applications for income / caste certificates

conditions.text: You must have lived in the state for the minimum period your state requires.

requirements.label: Aadhaar
requirements.detail: Commonly used for identity.

requirements.label: Proof of stay
requirements.detail: Any one of these is typically accepted:

alternatives.label: Utility bills or school records
alternatives.detail: Showing long-term residence at the address.

steps.title: Keep Aadhaar and proof-of-stay documents ready.
Apply on your state's revenue / e-district portal or at the tehsil office.
Complete local verification if asked.
Collect the certificate and check the details carefully.

obtain.where: State Revenue Department — tehsil / taluka office or state e-district portal.
obtain.how: Process varies by state, so confirm the current form on your state's official portal.

title: Ration Card
goalPhrases: how to get a ration card
summary: Family document for subsidised food grains via the public distribution system. Also widely used as family address proof.
uses: Support for other certificates and schemes

conditions.text: One family typically holds one ration card for its current address.

requirements.label: Aadhaar of family members
requirements.detail: Usually needed for the head of family and members being added.

requirements.label: Family and address details
requirements.detail: Names, ages, and current address for all members.

steps.title: Keep family Aadhaar details and address proof ready.
Apply on your state's food-supplies portal or at the local ration office.
Complete verification if asked.
Collect the card or download it as instructed by your state.

obtain.where: State Food & Civil Supplies Department — local ration office or state portal.
obtain.how: Process varies by state, so confirm the current form on your state's official portal.

title: Scholarships (General Guide)
goalPhrases: i am a student and need financial help
summary: Orientation guide: what scholarships typically ask for. Requirements vary by scheme — always check the official scheme notification.
uses: Understand what documents scholarships usually need
Find which prerequisite to arrange first
Reach the official application portal with the right papers

authority.name: Varies by scheme (central, state, or institution)

conditions.text: Each scheme has its own marks, income, category, and deadline rules — this guide cannot confirm your eligibility.
Final eligibility is decided by the scheme authority, not by this guide.

requirements.label: Income Certificate
requirements.detail: Most need-based scholarships ask for this.

requirements.label: Caste Certificate
requirements.detail: Only for schemes with category-based benefits.
requirements.condition: You are applying for a scheme with SC / ST / OBC or other category benefits.

requirements.label: Previous marksheet
requirements.detail: Merit and renewal rules differ per scheme.

requirements.label: Domicile or residence proof
requirements.detail: Some schemes ask for this, some don't — check the scheme notification.

steps.title: Read the official notification of the specific scholarship you want.
Arrange the prerequisites first — income and (if relevant) caste certificates take time.
Keep marksheets, Aadhaar, and bank details ready.
Apply on the official scholarship portal before the deadline.

obtain.where: The official portal named in the scheme notification (for many central schemes: National Scholarship Portal).
obtain.how: This guide explains requirements only — the application itself happens on the official portal.
